text: Python is a high-level programming language used for general-purpose programming.
A Python variable is a name that refers to a value stored in memory.
A function is a reusable block of code designed to perform a specific task.
An embedding represents text as a numerical vector that captures its semantic meaning.
Semantic search finds documents based on meaning rather than only matching exact keywords.
A language model can process text and generate predictions based on patterns learned from data.
A database is used to store and organize data so that it can be retrieved efficiently.
A primary key uniquely identifies each record in a database table.
SQL is a language used to query and manage data stored in relational databases.
Git is a version control system that tracks changes to files and helps developers collaborate.
